title: Blind shoot — what to do once confirmed

common.preserved_uncertainty: Sources differ on where to cut (ARC-BUSHROSE-NOFLOWERS-01 C-4): RHS cuts back by half to a strong bud; a public rose garden cuts to the next leaf joint down. Both are shown as 'Sources disagree' (Founder approval of 18 October 2026, replacing decision D6(a), which used the RHS cut point alone). A breeder's third cut point is not shown (Founder direction of 8 October 2026).

choices.label: Cut it back to a strong bud

cut_method.text: Cut the blind shoot back so it can send up a new shoot that can flower later in the season.
Sources disagree on where to cut: one cuts it back by about half, to a strong bud; another cuts to the next leaf joint down.
One source removes a short blind shoot growing low on old wood completely.
